label: Currency Euro
depicts: Standalone euro currency sign with two horizontal crossbars across the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants the euro symbol by itself with no surrounding ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ring euro sign when the symbol should stay inside a circle.

label: Currency Lira
depicts: Lira currency sign centered inside a thin outer ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the lira symbol centered inside a circular ring frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the standalone lira symbol when the ring should not remain around it.

label: Currency Lira
depicts: Standalone lira currency sign with two diagonal crossbars across one curved stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants the lira symbol alone with its two diagonal crossbars visible.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ring lira sign when the symbol should remain inside a circle.

label: Currency Nigeria
depicts: Naira currency sign centered inside a thin outer ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the naira symbol enclosed inside one circular ring.

label: Currency Nigeria
